name: Pakistan Affairs · Geography, Water & Natural Resources
title: Pakistan Affairs · Geography, Water & Natural Resources
subtitle: Practice bank topic · 65 MCQs
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Keys were cross-checked and corrected where needed; items marked Low confidence are noted in the explanation.
source: https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies (topic chapters: history, constitution, geography, economy, foreign relations, culture)
Key checks: na.gov.pk / Constitution Art. 51 (NA seats), Wikipedia & Gazette of India 17 Aug 1947 (Radcliffe Award), cabinet.gov.pk 1958 cabinet list (Bhutto as Commerce Minister)

questions.text: Kalabagh iron deposits are largest in Pakistan with an estimated reserve of _________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: reserve estimates for Kalabagh iron ore vary by source (≈300–350 million tons). Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: In the Hindukush mountains all passes connect Pakistan with ____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Afghanistan. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: The Hasni tribe is settled in __________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: Hasni tribe are Baloch; key retained from past-paper solutions. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: The Pakistan Forest Institute, a national organization was established in _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1947. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Relics of stone tools found in caves and terraces that date back to Pleistocene period have been discovered in __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Punjab. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Recent earthquake of October, 2005 was result of _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Tectonic dislocation. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Tethys’s deposits finally turned to be _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Himalayas. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: The Salt Range lies in the large accumulation of pure salt at Khewra and _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Kalabagh. Source: CSS 2006 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2006/).

questions.text: Durand Line, which divides the borders of Pakistan and Afghanistan is as long as _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: None of these. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Which mountain range is located between China and Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: None of these. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: What is the total area of Pakistan (Sq Km)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 796096. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: The height of Pakistan’s highest mountain Pak-Godwin Austin is as high as _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 28,250 ft. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: The Government of Pakistan established the Indus River System Authority in the year _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1992. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Under the Indus Water Treaty of 1960 Pakistan has the right to use exclusively the water of ____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Chenab, Jhelum and Indus. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: When was gas (natural) discovered at Sui Baluchistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1952. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: The Suleiman Mountain, one of the Western, is as high as ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: None of these. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: When Indus Water Treaty was signed between India and Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1960. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: Which pass connects Parachanar and Kohat with Afghanistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Kurram pass. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: Majority of Southern Pakistan population lives along the
questions.explanation: Answer: River Indus. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: The largest concrete dam in the world?
questions.explanation: Answer: The Three Gorges Dam. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: The largest agency of former FATA (by area) was ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: South Waziristan. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: Convergence point of five rivers in Pakistan is ___________.

options.A: Panjnad, Ali Pur Tehsil, Muzaffargarh District

questions.explanation: Answer: Panjnad, Ali Pur Tehsil, Muzaffargarh District. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Murree is situated in which mountainous range?
questions.explanation: Note: Murree lies in the outer (sub-) Himalaya; many Pakistani texts place it in the Pir Panjal range. Source: CSS 2018 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2018/).

questions.text: Qadirabad Barrage is built on which river?
questions.explanation: Answer: Chenab River. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: What is the total length of Pakistan’s coastal area in miles?
questions.explanation: Answer: 650. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: Tanda dam is located in which province of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: The total area of Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA) is ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 27220 sq km. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: Which pass connects Chitral with Dir in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa?
questions.explanation: Answer: Lowari Pass. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: The highest polo ground in the world is situated in Pakistan at:
questions.explanation: Answer: Shandur. Source: CSS 2023 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2023/).

questions.text: Which pass connects Pakistan with Afghanistan?
questions.explanation: Answer: Khyber Pass. Source: CSS 2023 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2023/).

questions.text: Which is the smallest province of Pakistan by area?
questions.explanation: The smallest province of Pakistan by area is Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Gwadar is located in the _?
questions.explanation: Gwadar is located in Balochistan, Pakistan's largest province by area. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which is the largest district of Balochistan by area?
questions.explanation: The largest district of Balochistan by area is Chagai. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: Which city in Punjab was renamed as Sahiwal in 1966?
questions.explanation: The city of Montgomery in Punjab was renamed as Sahiwal in 1966. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: PATA stands for_?
questions.explanation: PATA stands for Provincially Administered Tribal Areas, which were regions under the administrative control of provincial governments rather than the federal government. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: Which is the second largest province of Pakistan in terms of population?
questions.explanation: The second largest province of Pakistan in terms of population is Sindh. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: Kasur is located in which division?
questions.explanation: Kasur is located in Lahore Division of Punjab province. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: Skardu is in which division of Gilgit Baltistan?
questions.explanation: Skardu is located in the Baltistan division of Gilgit Baltistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/administrative-divisions).

questions.text: Which country is situated in the east of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: India is situated to the east of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Gwadar remained under Oman's rule for years.
questions.explanation: Gwadar remained under Oman's rule for 174 years before Pakistan purchased it in 1958. Low confidence: Oman held Gwadar c.1783/84–1958 (≈174–175 years). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: How many seaports are there in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Pakistan has three major operational seaports: Karachi Port, Port Qasim, and Gwadar Port. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location).

questions.text: Which is located North and North East of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: China is located to the North and North East of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location).

questions.text: Which from the following countries is not bordered by Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh does not share a border with Pakistan as it is located over 2,000 km away and was separated from Pakistan in 1971. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location).

questions.text: _ is located at the border between Sindh and Indian State of Gujarat:
questions.explanation: Shakoor Lake is located at the border between Sindh and the Indian State of Gujarat. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location).

questions.text: Durand Line Treaty was signed between Sir Mortimer Durand and King of Afghanistan in 1893.
questions.explanation: The Durand Line Treaty was signed in 1893 between Sir Mortimer Durand and King Abdul Rehman of Afghanistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/borders-strategic-location).

questions.text: In which city was the Indus Water Treaty signed by the Prime Minister of India and the President of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Indus Water Treaty was signed in Karachi on September 19, 1960, by Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru of India and President Ayub Khan of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/canal-water-dispute-indus-waters-treaty) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Indus Water Treaty disallowed Pakistan to use water of one of the following rivers?
questions.explanation: Under the Indus Waters Treaty (1960), Pakistan was disallowed from using the water of the Sutlej River, which was allocated to India along with the Ravi and Beas as Eastern Rivers. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/canal-water-dispute-indus-waters-treaty).

questions.text: Indus Waters Treaty was signed in at _?
questions.explanation: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on 19th September 1960 at Karachi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/canal-water-dispute-indus-waters-treaty).

questions.text: Which international organization brokered the Indus Waters Treaty of 1960 between India and Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Indus Waters Treaty of 1960 between India and Pakistan was brokered by the World Bank. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/canal-water-dispute-indus-waters-treaty).

questions.text: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on 19 September 1960 by _?

options.B: Jawaharlal Nehru and Liaquat Ali Khan
options.C: Lal Bahadur Shastri and Ayub Khan

questions.explanation: The Indus Waters Treaty was signed on 19 September 1960 by Jawaharlal Nehru and Ayub Khan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/canal-water-dispute-indus-waters-treaty).

questions.text: Which city of Pakistan receives the highest annual rainfall?
questions.explanation: Murree receives the highest annual rainfall in Pakistan, with an average exceeding 1,700 mm per year. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/climate-natural-resources) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The Pothohar Plateau contains the mineral deposits?
questions.explanation: The Pothohar Plateau contains mineral deposits of rock salt, gypsum, and limestone — all of these. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/climate-natural-resources).

questions.text: Where precious stone ruby is found in AJK?
questions.explanation: The precious stone ruby is found in District Neelum of Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/climate-natural-resources).

questions.text: Which country has maximum glaciers other than polar glaciers?
questions.explanation: Pakistan has the maximum number of glaciers outside the polar regions. Low confidence: Pakistan is often said to have the most glaciers outside the polar regions; figures vary by source. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/climate-natural-resources).

questions.text: What is the longest glacier in the Karakoram and second-longest in the world's non-polar areas?
questions.explanation: The Siachen Glacier is the longest glacier in the Karakoram Range and the second-longest glacier in the world's non-polar areas. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which is the largest lake in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The largest lake in Pakistan is Manchar Lake, located in the Dadu district of Sindh. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which of these mountain is less than 8000 meters high?
questions.explanation: Ganga Choti is a mountain in Pakistan that is less than 8,000 meters high, with an elevation of approximately 3,044 meters. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features).

questions.text: In which region is the famous peak "Tao Butt" situated in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The famous peak "Tao Butt" is situated in AJK (Azad Jammu and Kashmir). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features).

questions.text: Karoonjhar Mountains are located in ?
questions.explanation: Karoonjhar Mountains are located in Tharparkar district of Sindh. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features).

questions.text: Pasni port is located in ?
questions.explanation: Pasni port is located in Balochistan, along the Makran coastal belt. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/physical-features).

questions.text: What was the old name of Sukkur Barrage?
questions.explanation: The old name of Sukkur Barrage was Lloyd Barrage. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/rivers-dams-water-resources) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Near which city is Marala Barrage located?
questions.explanation: Marala Barrage is located near Sialkot in Punjab, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/rivers-dams-water-resources).

questions.text: Tarbela Dam is built on which river?
questions.explanation: Tarbela Dam is built on the Indus River. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/rivers-dams-water-resources) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which river is not located in Balochistan?
questions.explanation: The Shyok River is not located in Balochistan; it flows through Gilgit-Baltistan and is a tributary of the Indus River. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/rivers-dams-water-resources) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The vale of Peshawar is drained by _ river.
questions.explanation: The vale of Peshawar is drained by the Kabul River. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/rivers-dams-water-resources) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.
